newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Clark resigns as MD of South Africa's Telkom.
newsitem.headline: Clark resigns as MD of South Africa's Telkom.

text.p: South Africa's Telkom said on Wednesaday that managing director Brian Clark had resigned with immediate effect.

"Now that the transaction to acquire a strategic equity partner has been succesfully concluded Dr Clark is leaving Telkom to pursue other interests," the telecommunications utility said in a statement.
Last month the government signed a deal with a consortium comprising SBC Communications Inc and Telekom Malaysia Bhd to sell a 30-percent stake in the concern for $1.26 billion.
"Telkom is today a vibrant organisation, well poised to face its challenging future," said chairman Dikgang Moseneke in accepting Clark's resignation.
